sentences.text:
Revisionist :- Informant
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- Parvesh Kumar Pandey,Sarvesh Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
Heard Sri Parvesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the revisionist, Sri Ajay Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the record.

2. The present revision has been filed by the informant with the following prayers:
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow the instant revision, call for the record of the case and set aside the impugned Judgement and order dated 29.10.2024 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Mathura in Misc. Application No. NIL of 2024, State vs. A son of Digmabar Singh@Diggi, arising out of Crime No. 259 of 2024, under Sections 363, 452, 506,
376 I.P.C., and 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station- Baldev, District- Mathura and declared the O.P. No. 2 a major and directed to J.J. Board Mathura to transfer the case to Regular Court tried as major, so that justice be done otherwise the revisionist shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."

sentences.text: 3. The revisionist is victim of the present case.
4. At the very outset, learned counsel for the revisionist submitted that the present revision be dismissed as withdrawn as he intends to seek appropriate remedy available to him under the law.
6. Accordingly, the present revision is dismissed as withdrawn.
7. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of accordingly.
